doc.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025

title: Wrapping up and the Hamilton poster
summary: Rowe must leave, they thank each other and discuss a poster of Hamilton concerts.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I have the same thing. But anyway, I’ve got to run, Vince.
But this has been a real pleasure.
Yeah, you too. You too. This is great. And the thing you’re doing is really great. There’s a Skidmore poster back there, isn’t there? Is that a Skidmore poster back there?
I used to have one like that.
That’s concerts that we do here at Hamilton. And I got Joe Williams on this side and Count Basie on the other side.
